gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Rounded, springy and drawn like glowing tube. Noto Sans New Tai Lue follows with cupped, open letters in a plain sans, and its stroke pressure shifts gently where Comfortaa never varies.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-nko: Comfortaa's letters look bent from one gauge of glowing tube, loose and spaced out like a spring. Noto Sans NKo grounds them with a modern sans whose c openings you can see straight through.
gen-comfortaa-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Neon-tube curves, stretched out and friendly. Noto Sans NKo Unjoined sits beneath in sans-serif form, with small letters opened up wide, while Comfortaa's uniform tubing is best saved for big, short headings.
gen-comfortaa-gf-philosopher: Comfortaa draws every stem and curve in a single stencil-flat weight, with a round, loosely spaced c. Philosopher below swells and thins softly, a plain sans with daylight inside its curves.
gen-comfortaa-gf-rethink-sans: Rethink Sans keeps its openings generous at every weight, drawn in a plain sans line that never fusses. And Comfortaa overhead supplies the geometric, neon-tube friendliness, so the two feel like easygoing cousins.
gen-comfortaa-gf-rosario: Comfortaa's round, loosely spaced c looks traced from glowing tube, with stroke ends as wide as the middle of each line. Rosario's sans-serif c ends never curl inward, which keeps the pairing approachable.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sarabun: Comfortaa letters look like blueprint lines, constant in width and stretched out like an uncoiled spring. And Sarabun adds a plain sans body with a generous channel into every bowl, so the pair feels friendly and clear.
gen-comfortaa-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Hairline-thin neon loops lead the way, with Comfortaa's rope-like outline never swelling or thinning anywhere. Sawarabi Gothic follows as a plain sans, its curved strokes open and easy across paragraphs.
gen-comfortaa-gf-shippori-antique: Comfortaa brings a stretched, tube-lit geometry to the top of the page. Shippori Antique, a sans with bowls tipped open like a ladle, can be set at a generous size to match.
